name: NuBlox Developer Handoff Pack

authentication.permission_authority: NuBlox roles, overrides, project scope and domain policy
authentication.signup_policy: fail-closed; exactly one validated invitation or self-service organisation-bootstrap intent is required

account_provisioning.email_delivery_policy: provider-neutral; console local/integration only; production provider pending
account_provisioning.token_policy: random 256-bit invitation token; only SHA-256 hash persisted
account_provisioning.activation_policy: new membership activates only after persisted Better Auth email verification

organisation_bootstrap.token_policy: short-lived HMAC-SHA256 signed HttpOnly bootstrap token derived from BETTER_AUTH_SECRET; no bootstrap-intent persistence table
organisation_bootstrap.new_user_pending_state: pending users + pending organisation + invited owner membership until verified email
organisation_bootstrap.activation_policy: verified email transactionally activates domain user, verified user email, organisation and owner membership
organisation_bootstrap.existing_user_policy: active NuBlox user can create an additional organisation without duplicating auth/domain identity

permission_split.organisation.manage: organisation role definitions, permission grants and full organisation-administration authority
permission_split.member.manage: member lifecycle and member role assignment

organisation_administration.delegation_policy: non-organisation-managers may delegate only role permissions they effectively hold themselves
organisation_administration.manager_protection: lower-level member administrators cannot change the status or roles of organisation managers
organisation_administration.lockout_policy: member and role mutations cannot remove the final active organisation.manage authority

project_workspace.read_policy: project.view plus active project_organisations participation plus exact active project_members membership
project_workspace.create_policy: project.create plus active organisation membership; creation atomically creates owner participation, creator project membership and audit evidence
project_workspace.lifecycle_policy: project.manage plus active project scope plus owning-organisation context plus valid lifecycle transition
project_workspace.external_participant_policy: explicitly scoped external participants may view but cannot mutate owner project lifecycle
project_workspace.participant_administration: not implemented in this slice; requires a separate permission-controlled workflow
